row.title: SEED-DEPLOY-1: a generated system has no src/config.js until its bootstrap writes it
row.body: Lesson: the first OIDC seed deploy failed with ENOENT on worker/src/config.js because that file is generated by bootstrap and untracked, and it passed locally only because of a stale generated copy in the checkout. Fix: deploy/deploy-seed.mjs writes it from the system's own autonomy files before collecting modules. Observed: a clean out directory collects 90 modules. Probe: python3 -m foundation seedadmit --live exits 0 once the Worker answers /health. Open defect: the generated IDEA.md fails the bootstrap system test (bootstrap reports not a fit), so the system's own bootstrap cannot write config.js either.
